summary.repair_iteration_note: Repair-17 resolves the latest actionable Codex review findings for experience-record repo shape, recurrence ERR bounds, and inline YAML sequence parsing.
implemented_contracts: schemas/experience-record.schema.json accepts the PRD canonical repo identifier as a non-empty string.
schemas/recurrence-report.schema.json caps headline.error_recurrence_rate at 1 because ERR is confirmed recurrences divided by total agent-attributed failures.
relia check accepts inline scalar YAML sequences such as redaction.patterns: [api_key, token, password, secret] without weakening fail-closed redaction checks.
README, dev guide, architecture guide, and T2 decision note document the repaired schema and config contracts.

resolved_review_findings.summary: Experience records now use the PRD canonical repo string shape, aligned with coverage and recurrence schemas.
Recurrence report ERR is bounded from 0 through 1 and covered by contract tests.
The baseline YAML parser now treats inline sequence values as arrays, with regression coverage through relia check.
